limitations: Seven invented support cases are a smoke evaluation, not a representative quality benchmark.
The 63 hosted calls repeat seven cases; they are not 63 independent examples.
JEV is evaluated retrospectively against preserved historical data; fresh evaluation validity does not renew original operational evidence or authorize any tool or workflow action.
Business priority is compared separately from the original explanation; JEV does not replace the required reason field. Hosted explanations remain in the source and this report.
Raw classifier choice and confidence/eligibility gate acceptance are reported separately. Abstention is not counted as a correct automatic replacement.
Next-step states have a deterministic rule baseline. A classifier adds no demonstrated value for these explicit Boolean states.
Local NLI input-pair tokens and hosted generative tokens have different meanings and are not interchangeable. Cost and energy savings are unknown.
Historical hosted latency and present local latency are not a controlled speed benchmark. Cold worker/model loading is included in the first end-to-end call only.
No JEV choice is automatically deployed, activated in a workflow, or treated as validated for unsampled inputs.

mailbox.scope: One local sample per path on separate fresh SQLite databases; FULL synchronous WAL, validation and commits included. Frame construction, database creation and acknowledgements excluded. Not a production throughput or network-latency benchmark.

denseFallback.detail: Float64 is preserved exactly; compact JSON is smaller for this payload.

comms.scope: Payload bytes including shared context and annotations; excludes transport headers. Content type is required for either format. Local validated encode/decode; excludes source I/O, SQLite, network and batch accumulation time. Median of repeats; machine-dependent.
limitations: Binary wire savings are not LLM token, cost, latency or energy savings.
Batching can delay first-event delivery; choose flush thresholds for the workload.
Base64 adds bytes: the export is inspectable JSON, not the measured binary wire.
Each batch is independently decodable; no hidden context setup is excluded.
Batch codec and mailbox are opt-in primitives, not automatic runtime networking.

gpu.compatibilityOverride: Read-only bind of the installed host libnvdxgdmal.so.1 at its standard library and exact /usr/lib/wsl/drivers paths. This compensates for old Docker Desktop driver injection; no host files or Docker configuration were modified.
gpu.scope: The limit and peaks cover the PyTorch caching allocator. CUDA context, driver and other applications also use memory. Passing proves these seven complete inputs fit this run; it does not guarantee capacity for larger workloads.

spend.scope: This audit, CPU refresh, and publication task only; earlier hosted calls are retained evidence.
